Our primary metric is the Pass Rate, which measures the percentage of single-shot greedy decoding generations that pass the verification... We also report Pass@100, the proportion of test cases where at least one valid allocation is generated within 100 attempts.

Our primary metric is the Pass Rate, which measures the percentage of single-shot greedy decoding generations that pass the verification, i.e., produce a correct register allocation. We also report Pass@100, the proportion of test cases where at least one valid allocation is generated within 100 attempts.
